DIY Walking Path: The Full Step-by-Step! 🛑🔨 We took on this backyard project with ZERO rentals and did every single step manually! It was a lot of hard work, but the results speak for themselves. If you’ve been wanting to add a paver walkway on a budget, here is exactly how we did it: The Step-by-Step Process: 1: Layout & Planning: We marked the path with string lines and landscape paint to ensure everything was straight. 2: Manual Digging: Since we didn't rent a sod cutter, we dug the entire path by hand. 3: Prep: We used a hand tamper to compact the dirt base. 4: Edging: We installed landscape edging we found on @Amazon to create a clean border and keep everything contained. 5: Weed Barrier: We laid down a heavy-duty tarp (weed barrier) to keep the path maintenance-free ($55). @The Home Depot  6: The Sand Bed: Added a layer of sand over the tarp as a base for the pavers. 7: The Leveling: The most time- consuming part! We used a wood board to screed the sand until it was perfectly flat. 🥵  8: Setting Pavers: Placed 16 large pavers ($10 each) with even spacing. 9: High Desert Mini Rock: Filled the gaps with two scoops of High Desert Mini Rock ($70) for a clean look. 10: Solar Lighting: Added 2 packs of solar lights ($40) for that evening glow. 11: The Secret Weapon: Applied Rock Glue ($50) to lock the stones in place so they don't move! The Budget Breakdown:             • Edging: $70 • Sand 1 scoop: $15 • Weed barrier Tarp: $55 • 16 Pavers: $160 • High Desert Mini Rock 2 scoop: $70 • Solar Lights: $40 • Rock Glue: $50                           • Tamp: $40 Total Project Cost: $500💰 Check out the transformation!
